Commentary.Commentary: The spinning duo of Herath-Sandakan grabbed 8 wickets between them and that should tell you the story about the second innings. In all this we can't forget the efforts of the pacer Pradeep who got them the early breakthrough and then at the start of this session he grabbed the all-important wicket of Adam Voges. Can their batsmen put up a good fight in this innings? Join us in a bit for the hosts' reply.

For Sri Lanka it was all about their spinners. The veteran Rangana Herath was at his very best as usual but the name that will be remembered will be of the debutant Lakshan Sandakan who kept on troubling the batsmen. He bowled with high discipline and gave good company to his partner.

That's it for Australia! Sri Lanka have given an incisive fight to the visitors which sees them getting just a lead of 86 runs. But on this pitch one can argue it's a good one as well. A jist about the Australian innings - The openers departed early and this morning Smith and Khawaja couldn't continue the fight they showed yesterday. Adam Voges along with Mitchell Marsh came to the fore and stitched a 60-run stand between them before the latter got out. Voges departed early in this second session and some valuable contributions from the lower order saw the visitors getting past the 200-run mark.

Amidst the wickets tumbling, Adam Voges kept hold at one end and showed great intent to deal with the spinners. He is getting close to his Test fifty and his team will be really proud of the way he is battling it out. A special mention has to be given to Mitchell Marsh who dealt nicely at the start but was shown the way to the pavilion with an absolute beauty of a delivery. Stephen O'Keefe who had a good run with the ball is at the other end and it would be interesting to see for how long can he support Voges. The visitors now lead by 29 runs and would like to extend their lead as much as possible. Join us back for the afternoon session in a short while.

Pitched on a length outside off, Marsh plays it towards point. The fielder doesn't stop it cleanly. The batsman takes a single.
Length outside off, Marsh leaves it alone.
FOUR! Driven! Outside off, Marsh drives it through covers for a spectacular boundary. Marsh in aggressive mode.
Length delivery outside off, Voges cuts it hard into the ground towards the fielder at backward point who makes a half stop which gives away a single.
Back of a length ball, Voges plays it towards point off his back foot.
Length ball angling in, Voges defends it off the front foot.
Tossed up on middle, the batsman gets forward and defends it down.

FOUR! Superbly driven! Loopy ball around middle and off, Marsh makes room and drills it past the man at silly point who did well to get out of the way. The ball races away through the cover region for a boundary.
Gets behind the line and keeps it out with a solid defense.
Full and outside off, driven towards the man at covers.

Loopy delivery around off, Voges comes down the track and drives it towards the man at mid off. He sets off for a quick single and there is a shy made at the bowler's end. Doesn't hit the stumps and a single is taken.
Tossed up around off, defended watchfully by Adam.
Length delivery around off, Marsh defends it with the full face of his bat.
Marsh drives the delivery through mid off.
FOUR! Length ball outside off, Marsh goes for an expansive drive but mistimes it. The ball catches the outside edge of the bat and flies past gully for a boundary.
Pitched around middle and off, Voges works it towards mid-wicket and picks up a single.
Full outside off, Voges watchfully leaves it.
Wide outside off, Voges shoulders his arms.
Marsh prods forward and blocks it down. Well bowled, Rangana!

A loud shout for lbw, turned down this time! Loops it around middle, goes straight with the angle. Marsh gets forward to defend but misses and is hit on the pads. They appeal but umpire Kettleborough shakes his head as it was going down.
Loopy delivery around middle, pushed back to the bowler.
Full and around off, Marsh presses forward and defends it back to the bowler.
Mitchell Marsh is the new man in!

OUT! Herath on fire! A quicker deliver pitched on middle and off, Khawaja gets back in his crease to defend but completely misses it. The ball goes on to hit his pad straight in front of the wickets. It is dead plumb L.B.W. and an easy decision for the umpire to make. Khawaja has to make the long walk back.
Off-spinning delivery around off, Voges leans forward and to defend but ends up outside edging it past first slip. The batsmen run for a single. Voges is off the mark.
Pitched on a length outside off, Khawaja leaves it alone.
Full outside off, Khawaja drives it towards covers.
Outside off, Khawaja offers no shot.
Length ball outside off, angling in, Khawaja leaves it watchfully.
Length ball outside off, Khawaja shoulders his arms.
Outside off, Khawaja has no intent of playing it.
Voges dances down the track and plays the loopy delivery back to the bowler.
Voges pushes the delivery towards covers.
Straighter one pitched around middle, Voges defends it from within his crease.

NOT OUT! The decision stays as it is! Herath tosses it up around middle, skidding on after pitching. Voges lunges forward to defend but completely misses the line and gets hit on the pads. The Lankans go up in an appeal and the umpire shakes his head. Mathews after having a word with his bowler opts for the review. Replays show it was pitched in line and was clipping the leg stump. Voges survives a scare here and with that Sri Lanka have lost both their reviews.
Sri Lanka have taken an LBW review against Voges.
Adam Voges is the new man in!

OUT! That's a biggie! Tossed up delivery, Smith dances down the track to whip it but misses it completely. Chandimal takes it cleanly and removes the bails out. Good piece of work by Herath as he pulled back his length a touch as he saw Smith getting down the track. Perfect start to the morning for Sri Lanka as the Aussie skipper departs.
Off-spinning delivery pitched on middle, Khawaja works it on the leg side off his back foot for a single.
Rangana Herath will bowl from the other end!
Outside off, left alone.
Slight back of  a length outside off, Smith looks to defend it but ends up outside edging it towards gully.
Length ball wide outside off, Smith drives it off the front foot through covers and takes a couple. First runs of the morning.
Fuller in length outside off, Smith defends it off the front foot towards covers.
Pitched on a length outside off, Smith offers no shot.
Fuller outside off, Smith leaves it.

We are all set for the action to begin. The umpires and players are out in the middle. Steven Smith and Usman Khawaja will start from where they left off. Nuwan Pradeep will start off with the bowling proceedings. Here we go!!!

PITCH REPORT - Russel Arnold says it's rough. Adds it will turn. Further says there will be a bit of confusion in batsman's mind if the ball pitches in certain areas as it can skid or spin either ways. Informs there is nothing for the seamers, they need to stick to their lines and lengths. Ends by saying the first session will tell us which way the game is sailing.

Welcome back everyone! It is bright and sunny now but the weather forecast doesn't seem good as showers are predicted throughout the day. Hope to have a full day's play today after witnessing such an intriguing first two sessions on Day 1. We saw 12 wickets falling with Australia having an upper hand. So let's see how Day 2 pans out. Stay tuned as the action is about to resume.
...Day 2, First session...

Day 2 will start a little earlier, 15 minutes early to be precise. So the action will begin at 0945 IST tomorrow. Hope we don't have any interruptions due to the showers. Do join us for it. Till then, goodbye and take care!

Good day for Australia as they picked up 10 wickets and restricted the hosts to a low score. Then they lost a couple of wickets of their own and Sri Lanka had something to smile about. The visitors however are in a healthy position now and look good to carry on. The Lankans are not out of it by a long shot and can very well bounce back tomorrow. If today is anything to go by, we will have something to look forward to over the coming days.
Update 1624 IST - So, it's confirmed. The final call has been made and the news from the center is that play for the rest of the day will not take place. RAIN HAS WASHED OUT THE REST OF THE DAY!

Update 1600 IST - The covers are still on as the conditions have not yet improved. Chances of having any further play today seem very dim at the moment as the light has also deteriorated quite a bit. We can only keep our fingers crossed and hope that things get better. Stay tuned for further updates.

Oh dear! Not a pleasant news. The covers are on as dark and angry clouds have surrounded the stadium. It looks more like a precautionary step at the moment, maybe the groundsmen are expecting some rain. And as I'm typing, it has started to drizzle. Let's be positive and hope for some action soon. Stay tuned, we will keep you posted.
...DAY 1, THIRD SESSION...

Australia were well on top at that point but Sri Lanka started off well with Nuwan Pradeep leading the way. Dismissed Warner for a duck and that was a big wicket. Herath weaved his magic and soon sent Burns packing. However since then, skipper Steven Smith and Usman Khawaja have steadied the ship. Making a solid partnership of 59 runs, the duo is looking good and growing in confidence. It's set up to be an interesting final session here. Join us in a really short while.

A session which has mostly belonged to the Australians. Walking out to the middle, Lyon struck gold in his first over itself, grabbing two wickets and that opened the gates for the demolition of an already bullied Lankan side. 5 wickets fell within just 7 overs and Sri Lanka were bowled out for just 117.
Loopy ball around middle, Khawaja gets back and defends it towards the on side and that's TEA ON DAY 1!
Flatter one around off, Khawaja gets back and defends it towards silly point.
A silly point comes in place now!
Tossed up around middle, defended off the front foot.
On middle and off, Khawaja gets behind the line and defends it in front of short leg.
Loopy ball around off, pushed towards the man at covers.
Full and around off, Khawaja prods forward and defends it towards covers.
Angles a length delivery on off, Smith gets behind the line and defends it with a straight back to the bowler.
Fuller on off, driven straight to the man at covers.
Sweetly played! Fullish in the channel on off, Smith lunges forward, opens the face of the bat and guides it towards third man for an easy brace.
Full and around off, Smith pushes it towards point.
Harmless length delivery on middle, defended with a straight bat.
On a length and touch fuller this time, Smith defends it off the front foot.
No run.
Loopy delivery around off, defended off the front foot.
Fuller around off, Khawaja gets forward and defends it down.
Full around off, Smith flicks it to mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Down the leg side, Smith works it to down the leg side and the ball travels behind the wicket to the fine leg boundary.
Loopy ball on middle, Khawaja flicks it to square leg for a single.
PERERA is back on!
In the corridor on off, Smith lifts his bat and lets it go.
Back of a length delivery on middle, defended with a straight bat.
Good length on off, tapped towards the off side.
On a length and around off, straightens a bit after pitching. It's been left alone.
In the channel on off, Smith leaves it for the keeper.
On a length and outside off, Smith defends it towards the off side.
Played through mid-wicket by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Played through mid-wicket by the batsman. They pick up a single.
FOUR! Short ball on off, Smith works it down the leg side and the ball races across the boundary.
Full toss around off, driven hard back to the bowler.
Length ball on middle and leg, Khawaja times it perfectly, flicking it to deep mid-wicket. The batsmen have picked up a couple of runs.
Fuller around off, blocked to mid off.
FOUR! The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. The ball races to the boundary. The Umpire signals a boundary.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
BEATEN! Khawaja tries to cut it but misjudges the length and the ball passes under the bat.
The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.
Defended off the back foot by Khawaja.
Length ball outside off, punched off the back foot.
ANGELO MATHEWS into the attack now!
On middle, flicked to the leg side.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot.
Loopy ball, way outside off, left alone.
Worked to the leg side for a brace.
Blocked off the front foot, the ball gets edged to the leg side for a single.
Floated down the leg side, flicked behind square leg for a couple.
LAKSHAN SANDAKAN into the attack now! Let's see what the debutant has got!
FOUR! Full outside off, Khawaja leans across and slashes it through point for a boundary.
FOUR! Looped in on the stumps, Khawaja gets on the front foot and sweeps it cleanly through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Tossed up around off, worked to the leg side for a single.
Full on the stumps, flicked to mid-wicket for a couple.
The batsman has played it to the point region. One run added to the total.
Full outside off, driven through the covers.
Looped around off, swept to the leg side for a single.
The batsman has driven it through mid off. A direct hit by the fielder but the batsman makes it home. They pick up a single.
Played through mid-wicket by the batsman. One run added to the total.
Khawaja shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Full around off, driven through mid off for a single.
Outside off, played to point.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Blocked to the off side off the back foot.
Shorter ball on the pads, punched to the covers.
Around off, defended back to the bowler for a single.
Tossed up around off, flicked to square leg.
The batsman failed to make contact and was hit low on the pads. They pick up a single. Leg byes given by the umpire.
DILRUWAN PERERA comes into the attack.

Tossed up around off, Smith steps out and hits it right at silly point. He does well to jump and get his body in the way and block the ball with his buttocks. Smith is out of his crease and seeing this, the fielder there tries a cheeky little attempt by under-arming the ball throw his legs with his back to the stumps. It's a wayward attempt but a good one nonetheless.
Flights it up around off, kept out solidly.

FOUR LEG BYES! Poor line from Rangana from this time. Straying on the pads, Smith goes back and tries to nudge this fine down the leg side but it goes off his pads. Goes all the way to the fine leg fence for a boundary.
Floated outside off, goes off the inside edge to the on side.
Loopy and full on middle and leg, flicked straight to short mid-wicket.
Tossed up on off, pushed down to mid off.
Better line this time as it's closer to the off stump, on a length and coming in, Khawaja makes a watchful leave to end the over.
Pitches it up this time as Pradeep bowls it full outside off, Khawaja drives it back to him.
This one is quite harmless as well as it's well outside off. Easy leave for the batsman.
On a length outside off, arms are shouldered to this one.
Another good length ball pitched outside off, Usman raises his bat to let that go past him.
From around the wicket, a good length delivery outside off, let through for the keeper to collect.
Another one around off, tossed up superbly, Steven once again comes down the track to play but gets an inside edge onto his pads as the ball rolls away to the off side.
Nicely floats it up around off, Smith once again uses his feet to get to the pitch of the delivery and pushes it back to the bowler.

NOT OUT! Tossed up around off, Khawaja looks to sweep it but is hit on the pads. The batsmen run a single but the fielding side side appeals. The umpire isn't interested and signals a leg bye. They go in for a review and the replays show that while it was a legal delivery as the impact was not on the stumps.
The umpire has given the LBW appeal not out but SL have decided to review it.
FOUR! A similar ball and Khawaja looks to block it again. The ball takes an outside edge and passes a bit too wide for the keeper and makes it all the way to the third man boundary.
Outside off,  Khawaja blocks it off the front foot.
Pitched around off, driven off the front foot back to the bowler.
Smith shoulders arms to let that one through.
Outside off, the batsman lets the ball go outside his off stump.
Length ball outside off, left alone.
Down the leg side, Smith looks to flick it but misses.
A tad short on middle and off, worked to mid-wicket.
Length ball on off, blocked to mid on.
Landed around off, defended by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
BEATEN! The batsman has been struck on the thigh-pad.
On middle, pushed to mid on for a single.
Floated around off, Smith defends it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
FOUR! Full toss around off, Smith gets off the mark in style with a booming whips it through mid-wicket and gets it across the ropes.
Tossed up on the stumps, blocked with the full face of the bat.
Outside off, Khawaja chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
Length ball around off, the ball swings away and Khawaja shoulders his arms.
Back of a length and a tad outside off, Khawaja lets it through.
Wide outside off, left alone.
Good length delivery, angling away, Khawaja shoulders his arms.
Length ball around off, worked to square leg. A misfield allows the batsmen to scamper back for a second.
Skipper Steven Smith walks in next with Australia in early trouble.

OUT! Bowled 'em! Herath gets his first. He delivers an arm ball around off, Burns strides forward to defend, playing for the spin but it's not there. The ball skids on to beat the inside edge of his bat, kisses his pads on its way and then goes on to disturb the stumps. Sri Lanka are delighted!
Full floated ball on off, defended off the front foot.
Four byes! Down the leg side, Burns fails to sweep and it beats everyone before racing away to the fence.
Another front foot defense by Burns.
Full flighted ball on off, Burns defends it off his front foot.
Flatter arm ball on middle, Burns goes on the back foot in defense.
Terrific delivery, nearly catches the inside edge. Full and outside off, Khawaja attempts a loose drive and gets beaten.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Down the leg side, Khawaja tries to flick but misses.
Fullish on off, Khawaja pushes it to mid off.
USMAN KHAWAJA is the number 3 batsman.

OUT! It's a legal delivery and Warner has to walk back. This is a big breakthrough for Sri Lanka. Pradeep slips in a fullish ball around off, sharp in pace, 141 kph, Warner with zero footwork tries to play a booming cover drive but ends up inside edging it onto the stumps. The umpire checks for the no ball but the replays show that Pradeep was just fine with his landing. Poor footwork from Warner and he has paid a big price for it. Sri Lanka have got what they needed to lift their morale!
Warner is bowled. The umpire however wants to check for the front foot no ball.
Good length delivery on off, some extra bounce there, Warner defends it from the crease. Gets it off from the sticker of the bat!
Flighted on off, Burns strides forward in defense. An accurate and super quick over by Rangana Herath!
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Once again Burns is nicely forward as he jams out a full ball towards covers.
A tossed up ball outside off, Burns defends it off his front foot.
Lunges to a full ball and defends it to the off side.
Flighted ball around off, a touch shorter, Burns goes back and hits it through point for a couple of runs.
Rangana Herath to operate from the other end and I'm not surprised. A slip, short leg and silly point in place.
Beaten all ends up! Movement on this occasion as it lands on a fuller length around middle. Warner tries to defend it without much front foot movement and is beaten. Nearly edges it.
Angles across a length ball on off, Warner crouches a bit and hits it with an angled bat to the off side. Not in the gap.
Full in length and around middle and leg, Warner goes back and defends it on the leg side.
Fullish and angling in, Burns helps it in the gap at mid-wicket and gets off the mark with a single.
Full and it's too wide to bother the batsman. Another easy leave for Joe!
Starts with a length ball outside off, Burns watches the line closely and lets it through to the keeper.
